      <line class=
items.contentHtml:
Taking proper care of your watch and providing it with regular maintenance will help keep it working reliably. You can view our care tips here: 

Caring for you watch

items.title: Can I swim with my watch?
items.iconHtml:
<i data-v-ffb495fd="" data-variation="minus" class="ap-icon ap-icon--small ap-icon-minus ap-accordion__icon" alt="minus icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 200 200" class="minus"><line class="hand hand-1" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke" x1="100" y1="60" x2="100" y2="100" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round" data-svg-origin="100 100" transform="matrix(1,0,0,1,0,0)" style="translate: none; rotate: none; scale: none; transform-origin: 0px 0px; opacity: 1;"></line>
      <line class=
items.contentHtml:
Yes, if your watch is water-resistant. Make sure to comform to the depth indicated in the technical specifications and always check that the crown and push-pieces are fully screwed down before immersing your watch in water.

We encourage you to check up your watch water-resistance at least on a yearly basis. Such check-up is complimentary in all our Audemars Piguet boutiques and not warrantied.

Avoid contact with water for non-water-resistant watches and watches fitted with leather straps.

Learn more

items.title: What should I do when my watch needs service?
items.iconHtml:

      <line class=
items.contentHtml:
We recommend you bring your watch to a nearby Audemars Piguet boutique, repair centre or authorised retailer. Depending on the service needed, the watch will then be sent to the right repair or authorised service facility.

Where to service

Create an account to check your watches in, extend your International Sales Warranty and benefit from a complimentary pick-up to service your watch - for eligible watches & countries only.

Log in / Create an Account

items.title: Who is certified to perform repairs on my Audemars Piguet watch?
items.iconHtml:
<i data-v-ffb495fd="" data-variation="minus" class="ap-icon ap-icon--small ap-icon-minus ap-accordion__icon" alt="minus icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 200 200" class="minus"><line class="hand hand-1" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke" x1="100" y1="60" x2="100" y2="100" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round" data-svg-origin="100 100" transform="matrix(1,0,0,1,0,0)" style="translate: none; rotate: none; scale: none; transform-origin: 0px 0px; opacity: 1;"></line>
      <line class=
items.contentHtml:
Audemars Piguet has built a global network of skilled watchmakers that ensures local services and a consistent level of expertise. All watchmakers and polishers certified by Audemars Piguet undergo ongoing training and must obtain periodic accreditation of their technical skills. They undertake to use only genuine parts. Each watch is identified by its case and movement numbers to trace its service history. Our authorised service centres display a « Audemars Piguet – authorised service centre » plate with AP validation sticker and date.

Where to service

items.title: When do I need to service my watch?
items.iconHtml:
<i data-v-ffb495fd="" data-variation="minus" class="ap-icon ap-icon--small ap-icon-minus ap-accordion__icon" alt="minus icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 200 200" class="minus"><line class="hand hand-1" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke" x1="100" y1="60" x2="100" y2="100" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round" data-svg-origin="100 100" transform="matrix(1,0,0,1,0,0)" style="translate: none; rotate: none; scale: none; transform-origin: 0px 0px; opacity: 1;"></line>
      <line class=
items.contentHtml:
Beside the water-resistance that should be checked periodically, even more so if you are a regular swimmer, your watch should be serviced whenever you see that the accuracy or general functioning is declining.
Learn more about our Services here:

Maintenance Services

items.title: My watch is currently being serviced. How long will it take?
items.iconHtml:
<i data-v-ffb495fd="" data-variation="minus" class="ap-icon ap-icon--small ap-icon-minus ap-accordion__icon" alt="minus icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 200 200" class="minus"><line class="hand hand-1" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke" x1="100" y1="60" x2="100" y2="100" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round" data-svg-origin="100 100" transform="matrix(1,0,0,1,0,0)" style="translate: none; rotate: none; scale: none; transform-origin: 0px 0px; opacity: 1;"></line>
      <line class=
items.contentHtml:
The repair time frame depends on the calibre, the condition of the watch, and the work that needs to be performed. This lead time will be confirmed upon reception of the service proposal. 

A complete maintenance service on a model of the AP core collection can be repaired in 5 weeks. Watches under warranty are prioritized in 3 weeks. The Technical Advisors at our Audemars Piguet boutiques can provide an immediate estimate for most mechanical models manufactured within the last 25 years.

items.title: My watch is running fast. Why?
items.iconHtml:
<i data-v-ffb495fd="" data-variation="minus" class="ap-icon ap-icon--small ap-icon-minus ap-accordion__icon" alt="minus icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 200 200" class="minus"><line class="hand hand-1" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke" x1="100" y1="60" x2="100" y2="100" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round" data-svg-origin="100 100" transform="matrix(1,0,0,1,0,0)" style="translate: none; rotate: none; scale: none; transform-origin: 0px 0px; opacity: 1;"></line>
      <line class=
items.contentHtml:
If your watch is running fast, it may have been exposed to a magnetic field. If necessary, a simple demagnetisation process can be performed at an Audemars Piguet boutique, service centre or authorised retailer. Otherwise, your watch might need a complete maintenance service.

Learn more

items.title: Can a shock disturb my watch?
items.iconHtml:
<i data-v-ffb495fd="" data-variation="minus" class="ap-icon ap-icon--small ap-icon-minus ap-accordion__icon" alt="minus icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 200 200" class="minus"><line class="hand hand-1" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke" x1="100" y1="60" x2="100" y2="100" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round" data-svg-origin="100 100" transform="matrix(1,0,0,1,0,0)" style="translate: none; rotate: none; scale: none; transform-origin: 0px 0px; opacity: 1;"></line>
      <line class=
items.contentHtml:
As the result of a shock, the oil inside the movement can disperse, the pivots run dry and clearances in the wheel train may alter, ultimately making the movement unstable and in need of a maintenance service.

Impacts could cose an exclusion of the warranty coverage. For more information, please refer to our Customer Service General Terms & Conditions.

Learn more

items.iconHtml:

Audemars Piguet will not sell the Royal Pop watches. The watches will be sold exclusively through selected Swatch stores.
Questions about repair, replacement, recycling, and after-sales service should be directed to Swatch, as the watches are produced, distributed, and serviced through Swatch.
Therefore, Royal Pop watches are not covered by any AP services, whether it be the AP Warranty, the AP Coverage or AP Maintenance services.

items.title: What is the difference between a Certificate of Authenticity and an Extract from the Archives?
items.iconHtml:
<i data-v-ffb495fd="" data-variation="minus" class="ap-icon ap-icon--small ap-icon-minus ap-accordion__icon" alt="minus icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 200 200" class="minus"><line class="hand hand-1" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke" x1="100" y1="60" x2="100" y2="100" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round" data-svg-origin="100 100" transform="matrix(1,0,0,1,0,0)" style="translate: none; rotate: none; scale: none; transform-origin: 0px 0px; opacity: 1;"></line>
      <line class=
items.contentHtml:
The Certificate of Authenticity is made at our Manufacture in Switzerland after the watch is evaluated there. This document contains information about the watch and actual pictures.

The Extract from the Archives (or Extrait de Registre) does not authenticate a watch. It only certifies that the case and movement numbers appear in our records. Please note that only a Certificate of Authenticity guarantees the authenticity of the watch.

Service price list

items.title: How do I find out the value of my Audemars Piguet watch?
items.iconHtml:
<i data-v-ffb495fd="" data-variation="minus" class="ap-icon ap-icon--small ap-icon-minus ap-accordion__icon" alt="minus icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 200 200" class="minus"><line class="hand hand-1" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke" x1="100" y1="60" x2="100" y2="100" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round" data-svg-origin="100 100" transform="matrix(1,0,0,1,0,0)" style="translate: none; rotate: none; scale: none; transform-origin: 0px 0px; opacity: 1;"></line>
      <line class=
items.contentHtml:
We only provide watch value for insurance purpose. We invite you to contact your nearest Audemars Piguet Boutique, where we can assist you with that information. If your watch is still part of our current collection: we can provide the current retail price. If your watch is no longer part of our current collection: we will do our best to provide the current price of a similar model in collection. If your watch is more than 25 years old or if your watch is a limited edition: we will not be able to give any indicative price. We advise you to contact reputable auction houses to assess your watch.

items.title: What is the scope of the AP Coverage Service?
items.iconHtml:
<i data-v-ffb495fd="" data-variation="minus" class="ap-icon ap-icon--small ap-icon-minus ap-accordion__icon" alt="minus icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 200 200" class="minus"><line class="hand hand-1" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke" x1="100" y1="60" x2="100" y2="100" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round" data-svg-origin="100 100" transform="matrix(1,0,0,1,0,0)" style="translate: none; rotate: none; scale: none; transform-origin: 0px 0px; opacity: 1;"></line>
      <line class=
items.contentHtml:
The AP Coverage Service is a 2-year complimentary worldwide service offered under certain conditions by Audemars Piguet to end-customers. 

It is available for all Audemars Piguet watches initially acquired in 2024, 2025 and 2026, in our Audemars Piguet boutiques, AP Houses or via official retailers.

It protects AP Watches from the risk of burglary and robbery as well as functional damage, due to external factors occurring suddenly and unexpectedly, by offering the possibility, free of charge, to repair, refund or replace the watch, at the sole discretion of Audemars Piguet.

items.title: What is excluded from the AP Coverage Service?
items.iconHtml:
<i data-v-ffb495fd="" data-variation="minus" class="ap-icon ap-icon--small ap-icon-minus ap-accordion__icon" alt="minus icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 200 200" class="minus"><line class="hand hand-1" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke" x1="100" y1="60" x2="100" y2="100" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round" data-svg-origin="100 100" transform="matrix(1,0,0,1,0,0)" style="translate: none; rotate: none; scale: none; transform-origin: 0px 0px; opacity: 1;"></line>
      <line class=
items.contentHtml:
The following cases are excluded from the AP Coverage Service: 

Loss, simple theft (only burglary and robbery will be considered), normal wear and tear, aesthetic damage, damage resulting from air humidity or temperature influences, damage already covered by the AP International Sales Warranty, watches that have undergone third-party intervention or third-party modification, damage to a strap, voluntary damage, damage when the watch is in the possession of a third party, damage in connection with war and rebellion, confiscation by authorities, damage in relation to earthquakes, nuclear energy, radioactivity, chemical and biological weapons, damage in relation to cyber incidents, theft committed by persons living in the same household and fraud.

items.title: What are the prerequisites to activate the AP Coverage Service?
items.iconHtml:
<i data-v-ffb495fd="" data-variation="minus" class="ap-icon ap-icon--small ap-icon-minus ap-accordion__icon" alt="minus icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 200 200" class="minus"><line class="hand hand-1" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke" x1="100" y1="60" x2="100" y2="100" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round" data-svg-origin="100 100" transform="matrix(1,0,0,1,0,0)" style="translate: none; rotate: none; scale: none; transform-origin: 0px 0px; opacity: 1;"></line>
      <line class=
items.contentHtml:
The granting of the AP Coverage Service by Audemars Piguet is neither automatic nor unconditional. Prior the occurrence of either the burglary or robbery as well as the damage, you shall activate the service in your name, for each eligible watch:

1. Log in / Create an AP Account on our website. If you bought your watch in an Audemars Piguet boutique or an AP House, we invite you to use the email address provided at the time of the purchase – your watch should automatically appear in your account.

2. Register your watch. If your watch does not appear on your AP Account, you can register it online. 

3. Open your watch details and click on the link “Activate AP Coverage Service" to complete the form. 

4. Audemars Piguet will review your request and get back to you to confirm the activation of your watch's AP Coverage Service.

Audemars Piguet reserves its right, at its sole discretion, to modify the prerequisites of the AP Coverage Service's activation at any time and in any manner.

items.title: What is the duration of the AP Coverage Service?
items.iconHtml:
<i data-v-ffb495fd="" data-variation="minus" class="ap-icon ap-icon--small ap-icon-minus ap-accordion__icon" alt="minus icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 200 200" class="minus"><line class="hand hand-1" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke" x1="100" y1="60" x2="100" y2="100" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round" data-svg-origin="100 100" transform="matrix(1,0,0,1,0,0)" style="translate: none; rotate: none; scale: none; transform-origin: 0px 0px; opacity: 1;"></line>
      <line class=
items.contentHtml:
The service is available for all AP watches initially acquired in 2024, 2025 and 2026, in Audemars Piguet’s boutiques, AP Houses or via official retailers. All AP watches initially acquired in 2024, 2025 and 2026 are covered for a period of 2 years from the date of the initial purchase.

You may still declare the burglary, robbery or damage up to 5 days after the end of the protection period as long as the service has been successfully activated within the protection period and the burglary, robbery or damage occurred during said period.

We invite you to visit your AP account to check the validity end-date of your watch's AP Coverage Service.

items.title: Is any AP watch, regardless of its value, eligible for the AP Coverage Service?
items.iconHtml:
<i data-v-ffb495fd="" data-variation="minus" class="ap-icon ap-icon--small ap-icon-minus ap-accordion__icon" alt="minus icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 200 200" class="minus"><line class="hand hand-1" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke" x1="100" y1="60" x2="100" y2="100" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round" data-svg-origin="100 100" transform="matrix(1,0,0,1,0,0)" style="translate: none; rotate: none; scale: none; transform-origin: 0px 0px; opacity: 1;"></line>
      <line class=
items.contentHtml:
Eligible watches for AP Coverage, and for which AP Coverage has been correctly activated, will be refunded or replaced at Audemars Piguet’s discretion, exclusively up to CHF 500,000 (five hundred thousand Swiss francs), regardless of the watch’s value(1).

(1) the value refers to the actual price paid at the time of the original purchase

items.title: What shall I do if my watch is damaged?
items.iconHtml:
<i data-v-ffb495fd="" data-variation="minus" class="ap-icon ap-icon--small ap-icon-minus ap-accordion__icon" alt="minus icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 200 200" class="minus"><line class="hand hand-1" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke" x1="100" y1="60" x2="100" y2="100" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round" data-svg-origin="100 100" transform="matrix(1,0,0,1,0,0)" style="translate: none; rotate: none; scale: none; transform-origin: 0px 0px; opacity: 1;"></line>
      <line class=
items.contentHtml:
Provided that the AP Coverage Service has been successfully activated and is still valid, you can deliver your watch, in case of damage, to an Audemars Piguet boutique or AP House worldwide to request a maintenance service. In some countries, you can benefit from a complimentary online pick-up service for your watch (1).

You will be invited to fill in a repair request explaining the circumstances of the damage and the date of occurence.

Our Customer Service will examine your watch. If your watch is:

- repairable, Audemars Piguet will assume the costs of repair;

- not repairable, Audemars Piguet may offer, at its sole discretion, either the refund or, subject to stock immediate availability, the replacement of your watch (2). In both cases, you will be asked to assign your ownership rights of the irreparable watch to Audemars Piguet. 

The decision to repair, refund or replace shall be at the sole discretion of Audemars Piguet.

(1) The drop-off of a watch will not be possible in the following boutiques: 

- Audemars Piguet Boutique Amman

- Audemars Piguet Boutique Kuwait

- Audemars Piguet Boutique Beirut

- Audemars Piguet Boutique Doha Vendome

- Audemars Piguet Boutique Riyadh by Platinum Sands

- Audemars Piguet Boutique Istanbul

- Tektas Watches & Jewellery pop up

If you are concerned by the above information, we invite you to contact us at the email addresses indicated below. 

(2) If the initial purchase was made in one of our Audemars Piguet boutiques or AP Houses, the refunded price will be the effective paid price at the time of the initial purchase. If the initial purchase price was made in one of our official retailers' boutiques, the refunded price will be the non-binding recommended public price in local currency, applicable at the time of the initial purchase (VAT included). In the countries where we are not able to apply the non-binding recommended public price in local currency, the price applied will be the non-binding recommended public price in Swiss Francs, applicable at the time of the initial purchase (VAT included).

items.title: What shall I do if my watch is stolen?
items.iconHtml:
<i data-v-ffb495fd="" data-variation="minus" class="ap-icon ap-icon--small ap-icon-minus ap-accordion__icon" alt="minus icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 200 200" class="minus"><line class="hand hand-1" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke" x1="100" y1="60" x2="100" y2="100" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round" data-svg-origin="100 100" transform="matrix(1,0,0,1,0,0)" style="translate: none; rotate: none; scale: none; transform-origin: 0px 0px; opacity: 1;"></line>
      <line class=
items.contentHtml:
Provided that the AP Coverage Service has been successfully activated and is still valid, you can contact us at the email address coverageservice@audemarspiguet.com by submitting the following readable and exhaustive information:

- an authentic police report, dully dated, signed and stamped, which has to include the case and movement numbers of the stolen watch as well as the details of the burglary or robbery. Online police reports are not accepted. Only formal complaints issued by the nearest police station of the place where the burglary or robbery occured will be accepted. Likewise, amended or reissued police reports will not be accepted;

- your full contact details (first and last name, address, nationality, date of birth, email address, phone number). 

Audemars Piguet will examine the case and may offer, at its sole discretion, either the refund or, subject to stock immediate availability, the replacement of your watch (1). In both cases, you will be asked to assign your ownership rights of the stolen watch to Audemars Piguet.

(1) If the initial purchase was made in one of our Audemars Piguet boutiques or AP Houses, the refunded price will be the effective paid price at the time of the initial purchase. If the initial purchase price was made in one of our official retailers' boutiques, the refunded price will be the non-binding recommended public price in local currency, applicable at the time of the initial purchase (VAT included). In the countries where we are not able to apply the non-binding recommended public price in local currency, the price applied will be the non-binding recommended public price in Swiss Francs, applicable at the time of the initial purchase (VAT included).

items.iconHtml:
<i data-v-ffb495fd="" data-variation="minus" class="ap-icon ap-icon--small ap-icon-minus ap-accordion__icon" alt="minus icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 200 200" class="minus"><line class="hand hand-1" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke" x1="100" y1="60" x2="100" y2="100" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round" data-svg-origin="100 100" transform="matrix(1,0,0,1,0,0)" style="translate: none; rotate: none; scale: none; transform-origin: 0px 0px; opacity: 1;"></line>
      <line class=
items.contentHtml:
AP International Sales Warranty warrants new Audemars Piguet watches against any manufacturing defects for a period of 2 years from the date of the initial purchase (automatically extended to 5 years if the watch was intially purchased within our internal distribution network). This warranty finds its basis in the law and covers manufacturing defects. 

By contrast, the AP Coverage Service is a complimentary service offered under certain conditions by Audemars Piguet which protects from the risks of burglary or robbery as well as functional damage. 

Damage already covered by the AP International Sales Warranty are excluded from the AP Coverage Service.

Please refer to the Audemars Piguet International Sales Warranty for more information.

items.title: What are the main advantages of the AP Coverage Service compared to an individual insurance covering theft and damage?
items.iconHtml:
<i data-v-ffb495fd="" data-variation="minus" class="ap-icon ap-icon--small ap-icon-minus ap-accordion__icon" alt="minus icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 200 200" class="minus"><line class="hand hand-1" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke" x1="100" y1="60" x2="100" y2="100" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round" data-svg-origin="100 100" transform="matrix(1,0,0,1,0,0)" style="translate: none; rotate: none; scale: none; transform-origin: 0px 0px; opacity: 1;"></line>
      <line class=
items.contentHtml:
The AP Coverage Service is not an insurance. It is a discretionary service offered by Audemars Piguet free of charge. Therefore, no premium or deductible are payable by end-customers.

Compared to other similar services, our AP Coverage Service goes beyond the coverage offered by all-risk insurance on the market. Moreover, a service of this extent is difficult, if not impossible, to obtain in certain countries under similar conditions from insurance providers.

The AP Coverage Service may be granted by means of facilitated procedures, via an accelerated announcement and processing procedure and dedicated contact persons. In addition, the qualifying conditions are simplified.

In the end, the watch announced as stolen will be recorded as such in our files, which will allow Audemars Piguet to identify it in the event of a return to our network.

items.title: How will my personal data be processed?
items.iconHtml:
<i data-v-ffb495fd="" data-variation="minus" class="ap-icon ap-icon--small ap-icon-minus ap-accordion__icon" alt="minus icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 200 200" class="minus"><line class="hand hand-1" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke" x1="100" y1="60" x2="100" y2="100" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round" data-svg-origin="100 100" transform="matrix(1,0,0,1,0,0)" style="translate: none; rotate: none; scale: none; transform-origin: 0px 0px; opacity: 1;"></line>
      <line class=
items.contentHtml:
The personal data you provide at the time that you activate the AP Coverage Service or when you inform Audemars Piguet of the occurrence of a functional damage or a burglary or robbery, including the copy of your ID document when requested, will be processed for the purpose of the provision of the service. The copy of your ID document will be deleted once your identity could be checked. The other data you may be required to share with us in case of provision of the service, such as the criminal report, will be kept for 10 years based on the applicable legislation.

Please refer to the Audemars Piguet Privacy Notice for more information on your rights, the sharing and the storage of your personal data.

Privacy Notice

items.title: What is spoofing?
items.iconHtml:
<i data-v-ffb495fd="" data-variation="minus" class="ap-icon ap-icon--small ap-icon-minus ap-accordion__icon" alt="minus icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 200 200" class="minus"><line class="hand hand-1" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke" x1="100" y1="60" x2="100" y2="100" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round" data-svg-origin="100 100" transform="matrix(1,0,0,1,0,0)" style="translate: none; rotate: none; scale: none; transform-origin: 0px 0px; opacity: 1;"></line>
      <line class=
items.contentHtml: Spoofing is a cybercrime tactic where attackers disguise their identity to appear as a trusted entity, such as Audemars Piguet. They use fraudulent emails, phone calls, or messages to deceive individuals into sharing sensitive information, making payments to illegitimate accounts, or engaging in fraudulent activities.

items.title: How can I recognize a spoofing attempt?
items.iconHtml:
<i data-v-ffb495fd="" data-variation="minus" class="ap-icon ap-icon--small ap-icon-minus ap-accordion__icon" alt="minus icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 200 200" class="minus"><line class="hand hand-1" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke" x1="100" y1="60" x2="100" y2="100" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round" data-svg-origin="100 100" transform="matrix(1,0,0,1,0,0)" style="translate: none; rotate: none; scale: none; transform-origin: 0px 0px; opacity: 1;"></line>
      <line class=
items.contentHtml:
Be cautious of:

- Unexpected or unusual communications claiming to be from Audemars Piguet.
- Requests for personal, financial, or login information.
- Urgent demands for payment or other immediate actions.
- Emails with suspicious links or attachments.

items.title: How can I verify if a message is genuinely from Audemars Piguet?
items.iconHtml:
<i data-v-ffb495fd="" data-variation="minus" class="ap-icon ap-icon--small ap-icon-minus ap-accordion__icon" alt="minus icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 200 200" class="minus"><line class="hand hand-1" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke" x1="100" y1="60" x2="100" y2="100" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round" data-svg-origin="100 100" transform="matrix(1,0,0,1,0,0)" style="translate: none; rotate: none; scale: none; transform-origin: 0px 0px; opacity: 1;"></line>
      <line class=
items.contentHtml:
- Check the sender's email address carefully – spoofed emails often have slight variations from official addresses.
- Look for grammatical errors or inconsistencies in tone.
- Contact your usual Audemars Piguet representative or reach out to us via our official contact details listed on our website.
- Forward the message to our Client Care Cells

items.title: What should I do if I receive a suspicious email, call, or message?
items.iconHtml:
<i data-v-ffb495fd="" data-variation="minus" class="ap-icon ap-icon--small ap-icon-minus ap-accordion__icon" alt="minus icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 200 200" class="minus"><line class="hand hand-1" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke" x1="100" y1="60" x2="100" y2="100" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round" data-svg-origin="100 100" transform="matrix(1,0,0,1,0,0)" style="translate: none; rotate: none; scale: none; transform-origin: 0px 0px; opacity: 1;"></line>
      <line class=
items.contentHtml:
- Do not click on any links or open attachments.
- Do not provide any personal or financial information.
- Verify the request by contacting Audemars Piguet directly through our official channels.
- Forward the message to our Client Care Cells

items.title: Will Audemars Piguet ever ask me for sensitive information via email or phone?
items.iconHtml:
<i data-v-ffb495fd="" data-variation="minus" class="ap-icon ap-icon--small ap-icon-minus ap-accordion__icon" alt="minus icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 200 200" class="minus"><line class="hand hand-1" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke" x1="100" y1="60" x2="100" y2="100" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round" data-svg-origin="100 100" transform="matrix(1,0,0,1,0,0)" style="translate: none; rotate: none; scale: none; transform-origin: 0px 0px; opacity: 1;"></line>
      <line class=
items.contentHtml: No, Audemars Piguet will never request confidential information, passwords, or payments via email, phone, or text messages. If you receive such a request, it is likely fraudulent.

items.title: What should I do if I have already responded to a spoofing attempt?
items.iconHtml:
<i data-v-ffb495fd="" data-variation="minus" class="ap-icon ap-icon--small ap-icon-minus ap-accordion__icon" alt="minus icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 200 200" class="minus"><line class="hand hand-1" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke" x1="100" y1="60" x2="100" y2="100" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round" data-svg-origin="100 100" transform="matrix(1,0,0,1,0,0)" style="translate: none; rotate: none; scale: none; transform-origin: 0px 0px; opacity: 1;"></line>
      <line class=
items.contentHtml:
- Immediately stop any further communication with the sender.
- If you have shared personal or financial information, contact your bank and relevant authorities.
- Inform Audemars Piguet’s client support team so we can provide further guidance.
- Forward the message to our Client Care Cells

items.title: Who can I contact if I suspect a spoofing attempt?
items.iconHtml:
<i data-v-ffb495fd="" data-variation="minus" class="ap-icon ap-icon--small ap-icon-minus ap-accordion__icon" alt="minus icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 200 200" class="minus"><line class="hand hand-1" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke" x1="100" y1="60" x2="100" y2="100" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round" data-svg-origin="100 100" transform="matrix(1,0,0,1,0,0)" style="translate: none; rotate: none; scale: none; transform-origin: 0px 0px; opacity: 1;"></line>
      <line class=
items.contentHtml: If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Audemars Piguet, contact us directly through our official phone number or email listed on our website. Your usual point of contact and our client support team are available to assist you. Your security is our priority, and we appreciate your vigilance in helping maintain a safe and trusted community.

items.contentHtml: Once you have registered for a masterclass, you will receive an email from the boutique where it is taking place. The email will contain a secure payment link and details of how to pay.

items.title: How do I make a payment?
items.iconHtml:
<i data-v-ffb495fd="" data-variation="minus" class="ap-icon ap-icon--small ap-icon-minus ap-accordion__icon" alt="minus icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 200 200" class="minus"><line class="hand hand-1" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke" x1="100" y1="60" x2="100" y2="100" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round" data-svg-origin="100 100" transform="matrix(1,0,0,1,0,0)" style="translate: none; rotate: none; scale: none; transform-origin: 0px 0px; opacity: 1;"></line>
      <line class=
items.contentHtml: Once you have registered, you will receive an email from the boutique where the masterclass is taking place with a secure payment link.

items.title: Can I change or cancel my enrolment in a masterclass?
items.iconHtml:
<i data-v-ffb495fd="" data-variation="minus" class="ap-icon ap-icon--small ap-icon-minus ap-accordion__icon" alt="minus icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 200 200" class="minus"><line class="hand hand-1" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke" x1="100" y1="60" x2="100" y2="100" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round" data-svg-origin="100 100" transform="matrix(1,0,0,1,0,0)" style="translate: none; rotate: none; scale: none; transform-origin: 0px 0px; opacity: 1;"></line>
      <line class=
items.contentHtml: The buyer can amend or cancel their reservation up to three (3) days before the date of the masterclass indicated on the reservation confirmation and will then receive a full refund. For more detail, please refer to the General Conditions of Sale available here.

<i data-v-ffb495fd="" data-variation="minus" class="ap-icon ap-icon--small ap-icon-minus ap-accordion__icon" alt="minus icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 200 200" class="minus"><line class="hand hand-1" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke" x1="100" y1="60" x2="100" y2="100" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round" data-svg-origin="100 100" transform="matrix(1,0,0,1,0,0)" style="translate: none; rotate: none; scale: none; transform-origin: 0px 0px; opacity: 1;"></line>

items.contentHtml: Children registered for the "Little Watchmakers" masterclass need to be accompanied by an adult during the event.

items.contentHtml: Yes, it is necessary to create an account to enroll in a masterclass.

items.contentHtml: Yes, the masterclasses are open to anyone aged 16 and over. The "Little Watchmakers" masterclass is an exception, however, as it is aimed at children aged 8 to 12 who are accompanied by an adult.

items.contentHtml: No. Anyone who wishes to attend a masterclass must register. ONLY THE PEOPLE NAMED ON THE RESERVATION MAY ATTEND.

items.contentHtml: YOU MAY CANCEL YOUR REGISTRATION IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE TERMS SET OUT IN CLAUSE 5 OF OUR GENERAL CONDITIONS OF SALE (CANCELLATION POLICY). Please refer to our general terms and conditions for more information.
